title: Places in the app: the directory staff work from
question: One admin page lists every place in the app (pages, events, files) and lets you act on it: copy its link, announce it, change it (in a draft, in Media), and see who can open it. The picker in Announcements reuses the same view. Which arrangement?

options.label: Explore it beside a phone
options.lineage: a site map beside the screen it describes
options.thesis: The directory on the left, and the chosen place drawn in a phone frame on the right, with its actions under the phone.
options.viewport: Title band and search; area chips (All, Pages, Events, Files); a list of places grouped by area; on the right a phone showing Home as everyone sees it, with Copy link, Announce it, Change it in a draft and who can open it beneath.
options.risk: Only Home can be drawn live today; other places show a summary card in the phone until their features draw a preview.

options.label: Search with actions on every row
options.thesis: A large search across everything leads the page; each result row carries its actions (Copy link, Announce, Change) at its end, with area chips and what's coming up below.
options.viewport: Title band; a 640px search field; chips for areas; then rows under Coming up, Pages and Recently added files, each with small quiet buttons at its end.
options.risk: Rows get busy with three buttons each; fewer words fit per row.

options.label: The app as an outline
options.lineage: a printed site map: the app's own structure
options.thesis: The page draws the app the way people move through it (Home, Notifications, More and what's under it, then each area's items) as an indented outline; choosing a line opens its detail and actions beside it.
options.viewport: Title band and search; an outline: Home (with its tiles), Notifications, More → What's new, Help improve the app…, Events → each event, Files → each file; on the right the chosen place: name, who can open it, link to copy, Announce it, Change it.
options.risk: Items with no place in the app's menus (a file, one event) sit under their area, which is less tidy than the menus.
